name: valve_c17_ceiling_blast
note: City 17's collapsing entry ceiling (d3_c17_12b): a tiled walk along the canal tunnel's side, under a ceiling, ending at a doorway to a stairwell; the ceiling breaks with an explosion and a rubble pile drops in front of the doorway, and a clip can then shut the way for good

solids.from: func_breakable (taken shut, as a static slab)

trigger.name: entry_ceiling_breakable_1
trigger.what: the ceiling comes down with a blast and the rubble falls before the doorway (once)

trigger.name: entry_ceiling_debris_clip_1
trigger.what: the rubble shuts the doorway for good (Valve's, once the player is past)
